title: XC821150 Atlantic Puffin (Fratercula arctica)
author: Killian Sullivan
changes: Atlantic puffin (Fratercula arctica) giving its low groaning growl call at a colony off Grand Manan (Machias Seal Island area), recorded on a phone; terns can be heard faintly in the background. Trimmed to 11.90–14.30 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 200 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. The high-pass is set to 200 Hz because over half of the excerpt's energy is wind rumble below 150 Hz; the groan itself sits at about 400 Hz and above.
